item.title: J K Patisserie & Bakery LLC: Lemon Blueberry Loaf packaged in a cardboard box; Recall
item.product: Lemon Blueberry Loaf packaged in a cardboard box;
item.summary: Product contains undeclared soybean oil and soy lecithin in the Ingredient Statement. Soy was not declared in the Contains statement. Product details: Lemon Blueberry Loaf packaged in a cardboard box; Ingredients: King midas flour, Veribest pastry flour, Granulated Sugar, Blueberries frozen IQF, Milk, Canola Oil, Eggs, Lemon Juice, Lemon Zest, Baking Powder, Lemon Extract, Salt; Contains: Wheat, Milk, Eggs
item.payoutAmount: Refund, replacement, correction, or disposal if stated by the official notice
